transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well… I’ve been having trouble with eating. Once I start on certain comfort foods, I tell myself, “Maria, that’s enough,” but then my hand just keeps going back to the pot. It feels like I can’t quite make myself stop.
Can you describe what happens during these times when you can’t stop eating? Do you find yourself eating much more rapidly than normal or feeling like you’ve lost control once you start?

Yes… it’s more that once I start, I feel like I can’t stop myself. I’ll tell myself, Maria, that’s enough, but then my hand just goes back for more anyway. It’s… hard to explain, but it doesn’t feel like I’m fully in control.
Do you find yourself eating until you feel uncomfortably full, even when you didn’t intend to eat that much?
Yes… sometimes. I don’t mean to go that far, but by the time I stop, my stomach feels tight and heavy. I’ll just sit back in my recliner and loosen my waistband a bit… it’s uncomfortable.
After these episodes of eating more than you intend, do you ever try to make up for it by making yourself vomit, using laxatives, or exercising a lot more than usual?
No… I don’t do things like that. I just… try not to think about it afterward.
